{{Quote|You go, sir.|The Commando's last words to Palpatine|<ref name="ZBSB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>}}
This '''[[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]]''' was the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] escape [[H-2 executive shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] cut the ship in half, and the ship fell apart, with the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] trying to tear it apart; therefore the passengers of the shuttle fell out. After selflessly allowing Palpatine to escape on top of R2-D2 before him, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the Zillo Beast crushed him when it stomped on the shuttle.
